residual_risks: Windows/rmux sidebar settings mouse click remains blocked in rmux 0.9.0 because no precise settings-only coordinate or equivalent predicate is available in ordinary root bindings.
WezTerm mouse_reporting=true bindings can intercept pane mouse events but cannot safely limit the route to the CCB sidebar settings cell.
Direct send-keys c remains diagnostic-only evidence for the Rust settings action and must not be counted as mouse click parity.

rmux_precise_route.failure_detail: rmux retains mouse target/event internally but does not expose mouse_x/mouse_y or an equivalent settings-only predicate to ordinary root binding formats in the live CCB namespace.

wezterm_precise_route.failure_detail: WezTerm mouse bindings do not provide a configuration-level settings cell predicate; a mouse_reporting=true left-click binding would be pane-wide.

sidebar_settings_routing.failure_detail: No approved settings-only channel exists for native Windows + WezTerm + rmux foreground clicks; broad sidebar-left-click fallback remains rejected.
sidebar_settings_routing.diagnostic_direct_c: Direct send-keys c opened config UI in the parent foreground retest, proving settings action health but not mouse routing parity.
